propositions: Live agentic eval constructs a reusable PydanticAIRunner once before entering per-case disposable fixtures, so its LLMConfig.repo_path points to the eval checkout rather than each case's fixture root.

The runner's _effective_config method substitutes only per-request model and limit tuning but preserves the base repo_path, causing injected live runners' filesystem and ticket tools to read the checkout instead of the case fixture.
Completion-verifier cases that depend on fixture code files (src/cli.py, app/profile.py) failed with epoch_pass=[False, False, False] despite coverage=1.0 because agents could not see fixture files.

The fix re-roots the injected PydanticAIRunner at each disposable case store root and clears tickets_path to make ticket tools read the fixture's seeded store, applied only in the eval path without affecting production gate config resolution.
After the fix, all 11 completion-verifier cases pass in all 3 epochs with coverage=1.0, including the three targeted COMPLETE cases that previously read the wrong checkout root.
